summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of the Ambient Content Factory (3 channels: noadsNoise / Noadscolors / Noadshertz). Backend: 16/16 pytest tests passed including end-to-end FFmpeg render + Pillow thumbnail pipeline for all 3 channel types, media serving, matrix produce/batch, scheduler CRUD, YouTube settings/auth-url, and the expected 400 when uploading without a connected channel. Frontend: Dashboard, Matrix, Studio (SEO metadata populated), Pipeline (job detail modal with video/thumbnail preview), Gallery, Scheduler (add slot), Live Logs (streaming entries), and Settings (OAuth form + 3 channel connect rows) all verified via Playwright.

minor.issue: Returns 400 because PUBLIC_URL env var is not configured on the backend, so yt.REDIRECT_URI is None. Settings UI already surfaces 'PUBLIC_URL not set'. Real OAuth cannot proceed until backend .env has PUBLIC_URL. Not blocking for this test iteration (real Google creds intentionally absent).

issues: Radix DialogContent console warning: missing Description/aria-describedby (a11y). Add DialogDescription or aria-describedby to DialogContent.

action_items: Optional: set PUBLIC_URL in backend/.env so /api/youtube/auth-url and redirect_uri are populated (needed for real OAuth, not for this test).
Add aria-describedby / DialogDescription to Pipeline job-detail-modal DialogContent to silence Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~560 lines; still readable but approaching the 700-line split threshold. Consider extracting worker_loop/process_job and YouTube router into separate modules soon.
worker_loop is single-consumer (no concurrency lock) — fine for MVP but two backend replicas would double-process the same queued job. Add a claim/atomic update if scaled.
process_job's `log = lambda ...` variable is defined but never used; safe to remove.
generated/ media directory grows unbounded — no retention/cleanup on job delete (files stay on disk). Consider removing job_id folder on DELETE /api/jobs/{id}.
test_credentials: None required. Saved dummy YouTube OAuth creds (TEST_client / TEST_secret) via backend test to exercise /api/youtube/settings + /api/youtube/auth-url; this makes Settings show 'Configured' and enables Bağlan buttons. Reset by clearing db.settings.youtube if a pristine state is needed.
seed_data_creation: seed() runs at backend startup; created 3 channels + full matrix cells automatically. Tests produced ~5-8 real MP4 renders in /app/backend/generated/<job_id>/.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py covers all endpoints and the end-to-end render pipeline (parametrized across 3 channel types, ~35s total). Reruns are safe; tests clean up their own jobs. If PUBLIC_URL gets configured later, extend test_youtube_settings_and_authurl to assert auth_url contains state=<channel>.
